svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 740 mm of 32 mm PVC pipe. Cement a cap on the left end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a row of 3 mm holes every 75 mm along one side, starting

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm in from each side board position; deburr inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slide it through both side boards so it lies on top of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pad, holes facing down, and the open end sticks out 75 mm on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the right side for the feed hose.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: water from a hose runs out of every hole evenly.
